Confirmed 14 September. Booking reference FUW045023, name AARON ROSS BOCK, product "[Early bird] 2-day ticket", Adult × 1, $100.21 — about ¥711, or ¥356 a day against ¥475 at the gate, and under the ¥798 the official store wanted for the same product.

VALID MONDAY 12 AND TUESDAY 13 OCTOBER, confirmed with Klook. Two of the three park days are done.

PARK HOURS, from the booking: 08:30 to 21:30 daily, last entry 20:00 — better than the 08:30–20:00 the public calendar implied, which had not published October when it was checked on 10 September.

NON-REFUNDABLE AND NON-CHANGEABLE: no cancellations, no refunds, no transfers in whole or in part without merchant approval. The dates are locked.

PREMIER ACCESS IS NOT AVAILABLE THROUGH KLOOK — official website, app, WeChat account and Fliggy store only. Buy it in the Shanghai Disney Resort app on the day if a standby line crosses an hour.

Still to do: check the name and passport number on the voucher match the passport you will carry, and get the PDF onto the phone rather than leaving it in Gmail behind the firewall.

Confirmed 15 September. Booking reference UAY706135, name AARON ROSS BOCK, product “1-day ticket (free cancellation)”, Adult × 1, participation date 14 October. That completes the three park days.

NO PRICE ON THE CONFIRMATION. Klook's email carries the booking and the voucher but not the amount — take it off the Klook app or the card statement and put it in the Money row.

NOTE THIS IS NOT THE EARLY BIRD. You bought the free-cancellation variant, which is a different product from the ¥425–449 Early Bird I quoted, and normally dearer. You are paying for the right to change your mind.

WHAT THAT RIGHT IS WORTH, AND WHEN IT EXPIRES: full refund if you cancel at least 7 days out, so by 6 October; a ¥80 fee inside 6 days; nothing back on the day itself or once you have rescheduled. You can reschedule twice, up to 48 hours before 00:00 on the visit date — so by 00:00 on 12 October. The catch is that 6 October falls while you are between Shigatse and Lhasa: if you are going to drop the Wednesday, do it before you board the Z165 on 2 October.

The optional fourth morning: gates 08:30, out by 15:00, taxi to Pudong for DL 38 at 18:25. It costs a whole 1-Day ticket because there is no half-day product.

NOW OR NEVER. You cannot add it once you board the Z165 on 2 October — from there you are off-grid until Lhasa, and by the time you land in Shanghai on the 10th the date is a day out from the 48-hour horizon. Buy it before 1 October or let it go.

Still do NOT buy Sunday 11 October. That is the city day.
items.item: STILL TO BUY — Thu 15 Oct, if you want it

items.detail:
SUPERSEDES THE ADVICE THAT WAS HERE. This used to say skip it at ~¥179. The Toy Story booking includes early park entry, up to an hour before public opening, once per room across the four nights — the perk Disney's own hotels give their guests, and you are now one of those guests.

The hotel issues the voucher; no advance booking. Use it at the Disneytown entrance or the early-entry gate between 07:30 and 08:30, with your park ticket and the passport you booked with.

SPEND IT ON MONDAY, the first park day, on Zootopia and TRON before the public gates open. It is worth the most on the day you know the park least.
items.item: Early Park Entry — you now have it, free
